_comment: Demo answers for each prompt id in prompts.json. Flirty and suggestive for an 18+ audience, never explicit.
p_guilty_pleasure: Slow dancing in the kitchen at 1 a.m. Fully clothed. Mostly.
Ordering dessert first and making you watch me enjoy it.
Reading your texts three times before replying like I'm totally unbothered.
p_first_date_dare: Kiss me before the bill arrives. Bold wins.
Pick my drink, my song and my outfit for the second date.
Hold eye contact for ten whole seconds without laughing. I never win.
p_flirt_style: Relentless eye contact, then a wink when you finally notice.
Roasting you until you blush, then buying the next round.
Sending a song at midnight that says exactly what I won't.
p_green_flag: Lean in when you talk to me. Close enough that I forget the question.
A confident first message. Bonus if it makes me bite my lip.
Remember one tiny detail about me and use it against me, nicely.
p_late_night: Probably convincing someone to stay for one more drink. Could be you.
Deep talks, dim lights, terrible decisions I don't regret.
Raiding the fridge in your hoodie. Ask me how I got it.
p_wild_story: A rooftop, a borrowed jacket and a stranger who's now my favourite bad influence.
Missed my flight on purpose. Worth it. Ask me why.
Karaoke, a dare, and a very public serenade. I regret nothing.
p_kiss_review: One to ten? Let's skip the scale and you can rate it in person.
Previous reviews say 'dangerously good'. I'm open to new feedback.
I'll let you leave a review. Fair warning: people come back.
p_cheeky_secret: I always plan the second date during the first one.
I have a signature move and it involves a hand on the small of your back.
I look innocent. I am not.
p_unpopular_opinion: Texting first is hot. Waiting three days is not.
Slow dancing should come back, specifically with me.
Morning dates are underrated. Breakfast in bed counts.
p_perfect_night: Cocktails, a dance floor, and you walking me home the long way.
Candles, a playlist I made for you, and no reason to check the time.
Getting lost in the city at 2 a.m. and ending up somewhere with a view.
p_weakness: Rolled-up sleeves, forearms and a little bit of attitude.
A low voice saying my name like it's a secret.
Someone who can dance and isn't shy about pulling me in.
p_bold_move: Asked the bartender to send a drink to the cutest person in the room. Got a date and a free refill.
Kissed someone at midnight on New Year's before learning their name. We're still friends. Close friends.
Booked a one-way ticket and figured out the rest on the plane.
p_never_have_i: Never have I ever turned down a dare. Test me.
Never have I ever left a party before the good part.
Never have I ever been the first one to say goodnight.
p_trouble: Shows up with snacks, stays for the sunrise.
Laughs at my worst jokes and whispers better ones.
Makes 'one drink' turn into a whole story.
p_pickup_line: Are you a parking ticket? Because you've got 'fine' written all over you.
I'm not a photographer, but I can picture us together. Up close.
Is it hot in here or is it just the way you swiped right?
p_spice_level: Extra hot. In food and in everything else.
Mild on paper, wild after the second drink.
Start medium. I promise to turn it up.
p_dance_floor: The one pulling you closer when the slow song starts.
Dangerous. Hips don't lie and neither do I.
Front row, shoes off, zero shame.
p_type: Confident, playful, a little bit trouble.
p_red_flag: Steals my side of the bed and my heart. Mostly the bed.
Flirts with the waiter just to make me jealous. Works every time.
Always 'just five more minutes' when we're cuddling.
p_chemistry: We stop talking and the silence feels charged instead of awkward.
Our knees touch under the table and neither of us moves.
You look at my lips mid-sentence and lose your train of thought.
p_tease: Your playlist, your coffee order and how fast you blush.
How you pretend you're not checking me out. I see you.
p_after_midnight: A lot more honest and a little more daring.
The best dance partner you'll ever have.
p_simple_pleasures: Warm sheets on a cold morning and nowhere to be.
Your hand finding mine in the dark at a movie.
Someone whispering in my ear at a loud party.
p_two_truths: I've been skinny dipping, I can juggle, I've never been on a blind date.
I speak three languages, I hate chocolate, I once won a dance battle.
I've kissed someone on a ferris wheel, I'm terrible at cards, I've met a celebrity on a train.
p_win_me_over: A handwritten note and a cheeky wink.
Matching my energy on the dance floor and my pace after it.
Telling me exactly what you want. Confidence is the whole thing.
p_room_vibe: Candles, records, and a suspiciously comfy bed.
Fairy lights and a bottle of something red, saved for the right person.
Plants that are thriving and a mirror that's seen some outfit changes.
p_fantasy_trip: Somewhere warm with a hotel balcony and room service we never leave for.
A cabin, a fireplace, no signal and no reason to get dressed up.
Lisbon at sunset, dancing in the street, getting gloriously lost.
p_confession: I already picked out what I'm wearing on our first date. It's a problem.
I give the best back rubs on this app. Unverified but confident.
I fall a little bit for anyone who can make me laugh.
p_love_language: Physical touch. Hand on the knee, fingers in your hair, all of it.
Quality time, preferably horizontal on a sofa.
p_dating_me: Like a rooftop bar: great views, strong drinks, hard to leave.
Spicy food. A little intense, very addictive.
A playlist on shuffle. You never know what's next but it's always good.
p_bucket_list: A midnight swim somewhere we're probably not supposed to be.
Kissing in the rain in a city neither of us lives in.
Sneaking into a fancy hotel pool. Legally. Ish.
p_compliment: Tell me I smell good. Instant weakness.
Call me trouble like it's a compliment.
Notice my outfit. I chose it for a reason.
p_temptation: A good playlist and someone who knows how to dance to it.
A late-night text that just says 'you up?' from the right person.
p_signature_move: Pulling you onto the dance floor when you swear you can't dance.
Brushing hair out of your face mid-conversation.
A slow smile across the room that says 'come here'.
p_hot_take: If there's no chemistry by the second drink, there won't be by the fifth.
First dates should end with an almost-kiss. Leave them wanting more.
Bars are overrated. Give me a walk, a view and a reason to stand close.
p_sunday: Sleeping in, then breakfast in bed, then back to bed.
Pancakes, a long shower and a movie we don't really watch.
Farmer's market, wine by 3, couch by 5.
p_show_off: Salsa. I lead, you follow, everyone stares.
Cocktails. I'll make you something strong and sweet.
Making breakfast the morning after. It's a whole performance.
p_wink: Can keep up with my banter and my bad ideas.
Like long dinners and longer goodbyes.
Think a good kiss is worth missing the last train.
p_rule_break: No kissing on the first date. Never been good at that one.
Leaving the party early. With someone.
Playing it cool. I'd rather tell you I'm into you.
p_whisper: I've been thinking about you all day.
